what_the_change_does: adds an opt-in `deterministic_matching` dataset flag. When set, the exact matcher runs to completion on every page: the outer func_timeout wrapper is bypassed and the inner truncation deadline is disabled, so no wall-clock value can influence which algorithm scores a page.
what_the_change_does_not_do: no matching rule, cost function or normalisation is altered
the default path is unchanged, so artifacts produced before the correction remain reproducible under the terms they were produced
